Class DistributedLockAutoConfiguration

java.lang.Object
io.github.coderjeffery.distributedlock.autoconfigure.DistributedLockAutoConfiguration
@AutoConfiguration(after=org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.data.redis.RedisAutoConfiguration.class) @ConditionalOnClass({org.springframework.data.redis.core.StringRedisTemplate.class,org.springframework.data.redis.connection.RedisConnectionFactory.class}) @ConditionalOnBean(org.springframework.data.redis.core.StringRedisTemplate.class) @ConditionalOnProperty(prefix="distributed-lock", name="enabled", havingValue="true", matchIfMissing=true) @EnableConfigurationProperties(DistributedLockProperties.class) public class DistributedLockAutoConfiguration extends Object
Wires a Redis DistributedLockClient and the @DistributedLocked aspect.
